description: Reach a Cartesian hand target with the pinned Menagerie Franka Panda using MuJoCo Jacobians and damped least squares.
prerequisites: mujoco-menagerie 2026.9.0 Franka Panda object 3d2262eeb81e is available.
Target is position-only and lies within x=0.35–0.65 m, y=-0.20–0.20 m, z=0.45–0.75 m.
procedure: Reset to the model's home keyframe.
Read the hand body position and MuJoCo position Jacobian.
Solve damped least squares and clamp each update to model joint limits.
Compare damping candidates through separate simulations.
Execute the selected joint target with model position actuators.
Measure endpoint error, contacts, and limit violations.
known_limits: Validation covers 12 declared Cartesian targets, not the full continuous workspace.
Orientation, obstacles, grasp contact, noise, and hardware are not validated.
